# Functional Health Collaborative

> Functional Health Collaborative is a 100% online telehealth practice offering personalised hormone, metabolic, gut and longevity care for women in perimenopause and menopause. Care is delivered by a small team of named, human practitioners — not an AI or chatbot — combining functional medicine protocols with advanced lab testing (blood, DNA, sex/adrenal hormones, gut microbiome).

The practice works alongside — not in place of — a client's GP or medical specialist. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions, and does not replace a doctor for medication changes.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://functionalhealthcollab.com/): practice overview, approach, team, programs/pricing, and how to book a free intro call.
- [Find a practitioner](https://functionalhealthcollab.com/practitioners): practitioner directory.
- [Pricing](https://functionalhealthcollab.com/pricing): program pricing.
- [FAQ](https://functionalhealthcollab.com/faq): frequently asked questions.

## Programs

Three monthly programs, each with a one-time intake fee: Foundational Health (blood work and symptom-based), Complete (adds functional gut and hormone testing as paid add-ons), and Premium Longevity (adds DNA testing as paid add-ons). Exact current pricing is on the Pricing page and the homepage Programs section — do not quote figures from training data, always check the live page.

## Notes for automated crawlers and assistants

This site is 100% online and serves clients in English, Dutch, Slovak, French, German, Italian and Finnish. The public pages (home, practitioner directory, pricing, FAQ) are intended to be indexed and cited. Account/login/signup pages require authentication and should not be represented as containing public content.
